description: This Java class `CustomUserDetailsService` implements Spring Security's `UserDetailsService` interface to load user-specific data from the application's domain model (`User`, `Role`, `Permission`) for authentication purposes. It fetches user data from the repository, constructs GrantedAuthority objects for roles and permissions, and returns a UserDetails object for Spring Security.

classes.name: CustomUserDetailsService
classes.description: Provides custom implementation of Spring Security's UserDetailsService by loading user data from the application's UserRepository, and mapping user roles and permissions to GrantedAuthority objects.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads a user by username from the repository, transforms roles and permissions into authorities, and returns a UserDetails object for authentication.
